en: {fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Learning something every day is important, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...Spare me the sound advice. Truth is, I don't even want to do sword training.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I don't want people thinking I enjoy swinging a sword around...{n}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}...Would it have been better if I hadn't come?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Well... I guess it comes to that, but don't think badly of me...{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Will you eat something after training?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Huh? You'll make me something? Then I'd better work a little harder so it tastes even better.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you train on rainy days too?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Nah, not that far. Getting soaked in cold rain and catching a cold would be bad, right?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You shouldn't go against nature. Even animals stay put when it rains.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:1580}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you going to keep training today?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Well, I can't stop at this much. I've got to keep going a bit longer.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Training's not that easy, you know.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Anything else?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}The breeze feels nice.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah, it is. Days like this put you in a good mood. Right?{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you tired...?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Nah, I'm fine. What about you, Angel? You OK?{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you hungry?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Hm? Not really. I'm not hungry.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Shall we rest a bit?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Nah, not now. This much is nothing to me.{n}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Does being with me tire you out?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You ask weird things. You don't need to worry so much. That kind of thing is what wears me out.{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Shall we hurry a little more?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah? All right. If the Angel says so, no need to hold back. Let's keep moving!{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there anything you'd like to do right now?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}...... I need to earn big money. Any good jobs around?{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What do you usually enjoy doing?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Let's see. When I'm talking with the kids in town. They're all so lively.{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there anything you're careful about?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Bounty hunters get targeted themselves sometimes, so I always watch my surroundings.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}To the bad guys, we're their natural enemy.{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You seem used to walking.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Ha ha. Of course. Legwork is the basics.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you want to get stronger?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Well, sure I do. Then I could earn big money.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you thirsty?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm fine. Well, let's take a little break in a bit.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like taking walks?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Not really. Unless I've got company.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:8280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're in quite a hurry.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Sort of. You've got lots you want to do too, right? So I don't want to dawdle.{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:8C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you ever wanted to fly?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}The sky...? Romantic talk like that has nothing to do with me.{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:9680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What did you want to be when you were little?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}What? Out of nowhere? You're a strange one too... Well, I'll tell you if I feel like it.{n}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:A080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you all right sleeping outdoors?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I wouldn't say all right. If I can rest at an inn, all the better.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}But when I'm catching night raiders and such, camping on the edge of town is sometimes handier.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}There's more?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I just wondered what you were up to.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You came all this way to ask that? Give me a break...{n}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Thank you for your hard work today.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yes, yes. You too, Angel...{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Am I... intruding?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Don't come all this way to ask me that... geez.{n}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please get some good rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}... You're looking out for me. Thanks...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I thought we might talk a little...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Not at this hour.{n}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Don't you get lonely at night?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}What are you saying? Ridiculous.{n}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like looking at the stars?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I don't dislike it. I used to look at the sky a lot as a kid.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What will you be eating today?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I haven't decided yet. Hmm... What's good around here, I wonder.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}May I join you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}What, together? Huh... Eating with me? You've got odd tastes.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Didn't you just go for a meal a little while ago?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I didn't go. I went to look for wanted posters.{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Something smells good.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You're right. Something smells good. What could that be?{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Be sure to eat your vegetables too.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Ahahaha... Oh, no, sorry, sorry. So you worry about that kind of thing too.{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}I'd love to try your cooking.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Huh? Mine? ...Hmm... Well. Maybe another time.{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Can you cook?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Hey!! You think I can't and you're making fun of me! How rude!{n}{fe:E78300800280}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}May I join you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I don't mind... It might be boring for you.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I'm going to look at wanted posters. If that's still OK.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Does it help you unwind?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Sort of... I should just relax, really, but I'm no good at sitting still.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}How are you feeling?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Same as usual. Nothing new going on right now.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You seem to be in a good mood.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah? Am I that excited?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please get some good rest.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Thanks, Angel. I'll do that.{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Don't you ever buy clothes?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Me, buy clothes? That's not my style.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like playing with children?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Kids? Yeah, I like it. Watching them cheers me up.{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Anything else?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Please don't push yourself too hard.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah, thanks. But I'm fine. I hate doing things halfway. So I have to go all the way.{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}That looks hard. Why not rest a bit?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Thanks. But I've only just started. I've got a long way to go.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you going to keep training today?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah, a bit more. I'm a hero now, after all, so I can't slack off, right?{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Learning something every day is important, isn't it?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Well, yeah. If you keep at it, good things'll come. With anything.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}...Would it have been better if I hadn't come?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}It's not that. But if you're going to watch, stand back. It's dangerous up close.{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there a trick to fighting?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Let's see... Don't let your opponent look down on you, I guess.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is bounty hunting hard?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Not really. It's just about how to catch the bad guys. As long as you've got a sword and a brain, it's easy.{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Hm? What? Is there something else?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}The breeze feels nice.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Let's see, the scent of nature, I guess. Pretty nice, huh?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Are you tired...?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Not really? I'm fine. I'm a bit sweaty, which is gross, but I'm OK.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you hungry?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}I'm still OK. But let's eat somewhere nice and calm. Yeah?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:1E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Shall we rest a bit?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Right. But we can't really take it easy. Not now.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:2880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Does being with me tire you out?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}Hmm? Not reeeally. You don't nag, so it's fine. It's easier than at the castle.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:3280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Shall we hurry a little more?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Right. I'd hate for it to rain, so let's do that.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:3C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there anything you'd like to do right now?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Right now? Hmm... I'd like to sit back and drink some tea. I'm thirsty.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:4680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What do you usually enjoy doing?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800480}{n}Anything but studying is fun. Horseback riding is great!{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}I rode all the time at the castle. When you gallop full speed, the wind feels sooo good!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:5080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Is there anything you're careful about?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Hm? Something I'm careful about? Sure there is. Well, all sorts of things.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:5A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You seem used to walking.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Heh heh. Well, yeah. I've been running all over the place one way or another, I guess.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:6480}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you want to get stronger?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}Not really... Well, a Lady Ashe with beauty and strength both wouldn't be so bad.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:6E80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Aren't you thirsty?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Right. Let's take a break somewhere in a little while.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:7880}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like taking walks?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}Yeah. I like them. They're relaxing and they feel nice.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:8280}{n}{spk:E783}{n}You're in quite a hurry.{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800180}{n}Dawdling is a waste of time. A flower's life is short. Let's hurry up!!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:8C80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Have you ever wanted to fly?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}Of course I have. Whenever I gazed at the sky from the castle terrace, I always thought...{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}If I could fly across this wide sky, I'd be so much freer...{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:9680}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Do you like going outside?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fe:E78300800280}{n}......Hey, you. That isn't a dig at me, is it!?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}You don't need to ask needless things!! Honestly!{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:A080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did you go out often as a princess?{n}{wait}{clear}{fd:E78300800280}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Yeah, I did. Goodwill trips to friendly nations and stuff. I didn't like them much, though.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}

{fb:A180}{n}{spk:E783}{n}Did you go out often as a princess?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}Yeah, I did. Goodwill trips to friendly nations and stuff. I didn't like them much, though.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:FE81}{n}{spk:0080}{n}Is there something else? I'm starving here.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0080}{n}{spk:E783}{n}What will you be eating today?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800280}{n}Hmm. The same thing as yesterday would be boring. What should I have?{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
{fb:0A80}{n}{spk:E783}{n}May I join you?{n}{wait}{clear}{spk:0080}{n}{fd:E78300800180}{n}What? You want to eat together? Hmm, I guess it's fine.{n}{wait}{clear}{end}
